comment.comment: This tech actually seems amazing. With privacy being the meta right now, there are many different competitors and interesting projects like Veil, Nullmask, etc. This is because privacy when it comes it to crypto has so many different angles. Each project focuses on one thing, like anonymous transactions, token launching, etc. Omni is attacking all the different aspects in one. It truly seems like the holy grail of security and privacy in crypto. That in itself is extremely valuable, but at the same time I think for the average crypto user it is hard for them to rely on many pieces of technology for different functionalities. Having everything centralized makes it much more ideal for the average user, which is what Omni is striving to provide. We're obviously very early, but if this starts getting adopted, the potential is insanely high. The community here is goated too.
